claim: Nine of ten participants correctly interpreted all four states. One person confused metadata-only with an image that had not yet loaded.
92 percent distinguished confirmed from candidate. Errors were concentrated in color, not wording.
Eighty-eight percent correctly interpreted circa dates, intervals and open bounds. Two people did not understand why an inferred date displayed an evidence source.
Keyboard and screen-reader accessibility passed every critical task.
The candidate version is accepted, subject to three minor adjustments: a metadata-only icon, candidate-link color and the basis-of-estimate label. It may then be frozen.
